title: Harvard Mark I calculator in operation (1944)
author: United News / U.S. Office of War Information (National Archives ID 39033)
note: Black & white newsreel, October 1944. No PD ENIAC film found, so this is the IBM/Harvard Mark I (ASCC): an operator setting dial-switch panels, then tape and reading mechanisms. Source is a 1280x720 16:9 crop/upscale of the 4:3 film.

title: IBM SAGE computer installation: line printer and equipment room (1956)
author: IBM Corporation, Military Products Division (Prelinger Archives)
note: Color, 4:3. From 'On Guard! The Story of SAGE' (ca. 1956). Line-printer close-up with paper feeding, then a wide shot of the computer room with an operator. Upscaled from a 640x480 source.

title: Keypunch, punched card and card reader (SAGE, 1956)
author: IBM Corporation, Military Products Division (Prelinger Archives)
note: Color, 4:3. Airman at a keypunch, close-up of a punched card, then a deck loaded into a card reader. Same film as v-mainframe. Upscaled from a 640x480 source.

title: Teletype status printout during the Explorer 1 launch (1958)
author: U.S. Army (via NASA JPL)
note: Black & white. The whole 7.1 s source clip (JPL video 1446, ~1:51-1:58). The printout reads countdown / MAINSTAGE / LIFTOFF / EXHAUST FLAME LOOKS GOOD / STILL GOING / STARTING TO PROGRAM. Pillarbox removed; upscaled from a low-res (~530x360) source.

title: Apollo 11 launch-day control room consoles (16 July 1969)
author: NASA (Kennedy Space Center)
note: Silent 16mm color film, 4:3 (pillarbox cropped). Slow pan over operators at CRT consoles (Boeing, McDonnell Douglas and IBM contractor jackets). NASA's catalog title is 'Apollo 11 Mission Control Center - Film Rolls', but the footage appears to show the KSC Launch Control Center firing room.

title: Elektro, the Westinghouse robot, at the 1939 New York World's Fair
author: Audio Productions Inc. for Westinghouse Electric (The Middleton Family at the New York World's Fair, 1939; National Film Preservation Foundation)
note: Technicolor, 4:3, from an HD (1440x1080) 35mm transfer. Elektro turns to face the camera beside the presenter.

title: Alekhine vs. Euwe, World Chess Championship, Amsterdam (1935)
author: Polygoon Hollands Nieuws / Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision (Open Beelden)
note: Black & white newsreel, week 40 of 1935. Alekhine, then Euwe moving pieces. Side borders cropped and pixels squared (1280x1000, ~1.28:1).

title: Silicon wafer processing and inspection in an IBM cleanroom (Albany, NY)
author: IBM Research
note: From 'The future of computer chips is being made in Albany, NY' (4K source). Wafer process chamber, an iridescent patterned wafer, then engineers in yellow-lit cleanroom inspecting a wafer and a chip.

title: Aitken supercomputer racks, NASA Ames Modular Supercomputing Facility (2019)
author: NASA Ames Research Center
note: Color b-roll. Slow tracking shot along cabled compute racks. Brightly lit, not moody.

title: CDC laboratory scientists at microscopes
author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
note: Five short b-roll shots (scientists at microscopes, eyepiece and objective close-ups, a microscopy lab) from 'CDC Laboratory Science: Mission Critical'. Ends before the fade to an interview.

title: DNA helicase unwinding DNA, powered by ATP (molecular animation) (cropped)
author: HHMI BioInteractive; animation by Drew Berry (WEHI)
note: From 'ATP in Use' (4K source). Black background. Cropped about 17% (adaptation) to remove the HHMI BioInteractive corner watermark; credit HHMI BioInteractive and WEHI on screen.

title: Robonaut 2 with climbing legs, NASA Johnson Space Center (2013)
author: NASA Johnson Space Center
note: Color, black backdrop. One continuous camera move from R2's leg end-effector up to its torso and gold helmet as the legs move.

title: City lights of western North America at night, seen from the ISS (2011)
author: ISS Expedition 28 crew / NASA Johnson Space Center, Crew Earth Observations
note: Time-lapse from 19 Aug 2011 (NASA title: 'Northwest coast of United States to Central South America at Night'). 1620x1080 source at 12 fps, so playback steps slightly at 30 fps. ISS hardware is visible at the top and right edges.

title: Flight through the CANDELS Ultra Deep Survey galaxy field (Hubble)
author: NASA, ESA, F. Summers, J. DePasquale, G. Bacon, and Z. Levay (STScI); acknowledgement: H. Ferguson, A. Koekemoer, and the CANDELS team
note: Scientific visualization built from Hubble data. Slow forward flight past thousands of galaxies. The source's music track (CC BY 4.0) is not used. Encoded at CRF 23 to keep fine star detail.

title: Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo, on a rainy night (2012)
author: Guillaume J. Lauzier
note: From 'First nights in Tokyo'. Real-time, not time-lapse: crowds with umbrellas at Shibuya Crossing, several cuts. No PD/CC night skyline time-lapse of comparable quality was found. Encoded at CRF 31 to stay under 3 MB.
